note: Private RV park at 2068 US-76, Hiawassee, near Lake Chatuge (no water frontage); also motel rooms and cottages. Office hours 8-6, closed Sunday; the office is the third trailer on the right in lot #4. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 30/50 A sites with water and sewer, laundry, restrooms/bathhouses, $50 a night / $200 a week (at the $50 gate exactly; no gateway within 40 km), military discount (confirmed). Long-stay five tests pass on what is published: nightly rate on its own site + phone, no minimum, no lease/application, not a home community (no site count, so test 4 passes by default). Stored count 140 cleared (no source; imagery and RV Life say far fewer). Pool and rec-hall claims not on the operator's site and dropped from the note; good_sam false (directory-derived) left. Pin matches Google. Phone: see flag.
